raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Two exits free a request's KV with `release_kv_cache` without releasing its HiSparse state first, so the rows leak. Both now call `hisparse_coordinator.request_finished` before the KV free, under the same `enable_hisparse` guard as the other exits.

- PD decode KV checksum mismatch (`_handle_kv_checksum_mismatch`): the transfer has already admitted the request into HiSparse, so its host pages and device buffer were never returned.
- Chunked prefill abort (`process_pending_chunked_abort`): a request aborted between chunks holds only the spec scratch row its extend allocated; `request_finished` frees exactly that (its no-device-buffer branch), and the prefill KV is still freed by `release_kv_cache`.

No change without `--enable-hisparse`. No stream wait is added or moved; `request_finished` keeps its own wait on the forward stream, as at the other exits.

## Test plan
- One unit test per exit checks that the HiSparse release runs, and runs before the KV free; both fail without the fix.
- `/rerun-test` on this head:
  - `test_hisparse_unit.py` (1-gpu-5090): passed, [run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41746839763)
  - `test_disaggregation_hisparse.py` (8-gpu-h200, PD + HiSparse, DeepSeek-V4-Flash): passed, [run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41746854792)
  - `test_dsa_glm52_hisparse.py` (8-gpu-b200, HiSparse + speculative decoding): passed, [run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41746870316)
  - `test_kv_checksum.py` (1-gpu-h100): queued, [run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41746823280)
- The leaks are found by reading the exits and confirmed by the unit tests; an end-to-end reproduction on a server is in progress.

files.patch:
@@ -3775,6 +3775,8 @@ def _handle_kv_checksum_mismatch(self, req: Req, msg: str) -> None:
             status_code=HTTPStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
         )
         self.output_streamer.stream_output([req], req.return_logprob)
+        if self.enable_hisparse:
+            self.hisparse_coordinator.request_finished(req)
         release_kv_cache(req, self.tree_cache, checkpoint=False)
         if self.metrics_reporter.enable_metrics:
             self.metrics_collector.increment_transfer_failed_reqs()

@@ -4038,6 +4038,8 @@ def process_pending_chunked_abort(self) -> None:
         self.release_aborted_request(req)
         # No member rows exist before the leader's prefill ends.
         self.beam_coordinator.retire_group(req)
+        if self.enable_hisparse:
+            self.hisparse_coordinator.request_finished(req)
         release_kv_cache(req, self.tree_cache, checkpoint=False)
 
         self.chunked_req = None

@@ -255,6 +255,7 @@ def __init__(self, computer, req_to_token):
         )
         self.req_to_token_pool = SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=req_to_token)
         self.tree_cache = None
+        self.enable_hisparse = False
         self.output_streamer = SimpleNamespace(stream_output=self.stream_output)
         self.metrics_reporter = SimpleNamespace(enable_metrics=True)
         self.metrics_collector = Mock()
@@ -579,6 +580,30 @@ def test_backend_can_skip_incomparable_checksum(self):
         mock_abort.assert_called_once()
 
 
+class TestKvChecksumMismatchHiSparse(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_mismatch_releases_hisparse_before_kv(self):
+        # Transfer already admitted the request into HiSparse; the abort must
+        # free its host pages before the KV itself.
+        sched = _FakeScheduler(None, None)
+        sched.enable_hisparse = True
+        calls = []
+        sched.hisparse_coordinator = Mock()
+        sched.hisparse_coordinator.request_finished.side_effect = lambda req: (
+            calls.append(("hisparse", req))
+        )
+        req = _make_req(0xDEADBEEF, 4)
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_IS_IN_CI.override(False),
+            patch("sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode.prepare_abort"),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode.release_kv_cache",
+                side_effect=lambda req, *a, **kw: calls.append(("kv", req)),
+            ),
+        ):
+            sched._handle_kv_checksum_mismatch(req, "KV checksum mismatch")
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [("hisparse", req), ("kv", req)])
+
+
 _SENTINEL = object()

@@ -62,6 +62,7 @@ def _make_scheduler(pending_req, *, chunked_req, running_reqs) -> Scheduler:
     sched.last_batch = None
     sched.beam_coordinator = Mock()
     sched.output_streamer = Mock()
+    sched.enable_hisparse = False
     return sched
 
 
@@ -105,6 +106,28 @@ def test_aborted_chunked_beam_leader_retires_its_group(self):
 
         sched.beam_coordinator.retire_group.assert_called_once_with(req)
 
+    def test_aborted_chunked_req_releases_hisparse_before_kv(self):
+        # Each chunk's extend allocates HiSparse spec scratch for the row.
+        req = _FakeReq("hisparse_chunked")
+        sched = _make_scheduler(req, chunked_req=req, running_reqs=[])
+        sched.release_aborted_request = Mock()
+        sched.tree_cache = None
+        sched.ipc_channels = Mock()
+        sched.enable_hisparse = True
+        calls = []
+        sched.hisparse_coordinator = Mock()
+        sched.hisparse_coordinator.request_finished.side_effect = lambda req: (
+            calls.append(("hisparse", req))
+        )
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler.release_kv_cache",
+            side_effect=lambda req, *a, **kw: calls.append(("kv", req)),
+        ):
+            sched.process_pending_chunked_abort()
+
+        self.assertEqual(calls, [("hisparse", req), ("kv", req)])
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main(verbosity=2)
